title: Street Fucker 2 - T*rture

body.intro:
This time, we have dispensed with the fighting scenes and the conversation
scenes, and instead focused on completing the punishment scenes that
didn't make it in the previous product.

The female body model has been redone from scratch. You can now edit it in
far greater detail than in the previous product. Furthermore you can
redraw all the textures in the texture folder to create your own
customized outfit. During every scene, you can click on the part of the
model you wish to move to put it in whatever position you like. The goal
of the game is to sexually train the girl, develop her masochistic
tendency, and in the process unlock a variety of t*rture methods. When you
max out her masochism, you will be able to use the motion editor, a
special feature in this product.
The product comes with 5 predefined animations (when you leave the girl
alone for a while she'll get bored and start moving by herself). You can
change these animations freely. You can also create up to 26 new
animations of up to 930 frames, and save them for later use.
(Depending on your system's configuration, the total length of animation
is about 15 minutes at 30 prames per second.)
This product contains a rich real time component. With a drastically
revised version of Street Fucker, you can now enjoy in real time the
scenes you could not in the movie.

NOTE:
An english instruction manual was added on January 23rd.


MATRIX ENGINE IS NEEDED TO BE INSTALLED
Make sure you've done the following:
You must have the Matrix Engine installed. You can download it at the following page.
http://mxengine-se.net-dimension.com/english/index.html



* We highly recommend you try the demo version before you buy this product.
